title: Figure 10. Recombinant DNA molecule: restriction enzyme cleavage and sticky end ligation
description: Step-by-step schematic in purple tones showing two original DNA molecules with the GAATTC/CTTAAG recognition sequence, (1) cleaved by the same restriction enzyme, (2) mixed so sticky ends join by base pairing, and (3) incubated with DNA ligase to form a "Recombinant DNA molecule." Captioned "Figure 10. Recombinant DNA molecule with restriction enzyme cleavage and sticky end ligation."
